method.description: Finite-population endpoint plug-in ridge regression with evaluator-owned synthetic structural equations: M0 own-treatment; M1 linear one-hop; M2 nonlinear/interacting one-hop; M3 omitted heterogeneous two-hop threshold. Search: two synthetic graph families, n=1024, four seeds; final fresh n=2048 synthetic graphs and full Stanford3 n=11586, twelve seeds. Two assignment designs (node Bernoulli and graph-only BFS cluster Bernoulli p=.5), actual and exposure-changing graph-permuted arms. Fixed auditable feature basis [1,z,e,z*e,e^2,x,degree/max_degree,x*z]; solver/ridge selection editable; evaluator checks fitted normal equations, endpoint consistency and reset replay rather than internal flags. Equal seed/design/mechanism/topology weights (1/S,1/2,1/4,1/T), signed errors clipped [-1,1] after division by max(1,abs(GATE)); failed primary contribution error=+1, loss=1; control failure=0; missing paired comparison=-1; replay failure error=1. combined_score=.80*(1-primary_mean_squared_error)+.15*mean_control_pass+.05*replay_pass. Controls per pair: actual/permuted validity, fitted constant endpoint identity, fitted observed-group-copy identity, weights1/3 each. Paired gain/gap metrics are equal-weight means of single-replicate root-square loss differences, not differences of pooled RMSE. Seed-vector bootstrap512 gives bias and RMSE percentile intervals; single-seed smoke uses full bounded intervals. No comparative eligibility threshold and no adaptivity gate. Search correct means complete valid protocol, actual fitted method, all required baselines/controls and replay, disjoint data, fixed finite aggregation; final correct separately requires those prerequisites on sealed data, without requiring a positive superiority result. Narrative claim support is a later evidence assessment, not search veto. Platform Linux x86_64 CPython3.11/3.12, Landlock ABI>=3 and libseccomp.so.2 for native smoke, broker-managed no-network container in production. Candidate2 CPU threads/8GiB, evaluator2 threads/8GiB; native individual process RLIMITs plus affinity, harness owns aggregate container allocation. Each candidate and required baseline gets matched2.5s work, reset1s, cleanup.55s each; setup120s and finish20s production, smoke120s total with setup5s/finish5s. No canonical productive baseline-time floor. Only observable bounded fit evidence is tested, not exhaustive hidden-mechanism proof.

protocol.promotion_rule: At most three production search invocations total, one candidate per cycle. Eligibility is search correct, not comparative superiority. Rank by combined_score, ties by lower normalized_capped_rmse then lexicographic frozen source-manifest SHA256. Harness owns freeze before final and all promotion/publication. Exactly one permitted trailing first-seed/first-case replay after all primary and permutation episodes is included in each complete global broker-visible reset array: search129 production/33 smoke; final577 production/49 smoke. No replay exemption. Max production operation tables include replay: search129 episodes*(reset1+begin1+upload8+fit_commit1+predict1+release1)=1677; final577*13=7501. No other reset/replay/poll/reconnect allowance. Input transfer start and fit commit counted even for one chunk; no state export/import operations. Within-episode baseline work is trusted and sends no outputs to candidate. No scientific direction or final publication claim automatically vetoes search.

search_proxies.name: synthetic_development
search_proxies.preserves: All four mechanisms, both assignments, actual/permuted regression paths, all controls, fixed seed/case aggregation and failure accounting.
search_proxies.omits: Full public topology and fresh larger synthetic realizations, twelve final seeds; search has four development seeds and two smaller synthetic families.

search_proxies.name: draft_smoke
search_proxies.preserves: Exact same offline parser, imports, isolation, CLI, RPC/upload/fit/predict/metrics and control paths; all case types and one first-case replay.
search_proxies.omits: Production replication and graph sizes; first statistical seed only, 128-node synthetic and final 256-node public induced graph; no production throughput or scientific certification.

search_visible: search aggregate declared scalar metrics and bounded fixed failure categories after complete episode plan
search evidence raw validated estimates and baselines; no within-episode scoring feedback
final_sealed: final concrete seeds/manifests/examples and final smoke feedback inaccessible until freeze; only current permitted graph/x/z/y inputs released via RPC
final endpoint targets/baselines/oracle/control outcomes/scientific metrics/evidence remain optimizer-sealed

required_evidence: Complete research paper PDF and LaTeX using latest official chosen NeurIPS template, verified page limit and filled checklist; sections required by task.md; evaluator cannot automate this review.

Faithful claims with uncertainty, negatives/failures/incomplete work; uncapped and capped errors, per-mechanism/topology/design summaries, baseline/oracle and matched permutation comparisons. No universal superiority or node-iid confidence claim.

Reproducible code, exact pinned environment, graph/archive hashes/versions and source attributions, frozen equations and seeds, complete ordered reset traces and RPC tables, table/figure scripts and measured runtime.

Canonical independent-research access restrictions; cite only actually consulted real sources; immediately stop and record any accidental prohibited-content encounter. No prohibited literature was sought or accessed during scaffold preparation.
Normalized raw graph and x/z/y example separation including nonidentity permuted graphs, source/row provenance and split manifests before features; shared immutable code is not a held-out example.

Scientific validity and required controls completeness separate from eligible search ranking and conditional final claim support. Missing comparisons retain fixed penalties and forbid unsupported causal conclusions. Harness owns freeze/selection/publication.
